signals.name: decompressedBytes
signals.quantity: total bytes read from the InflaterInputStream during one fuzz execution, measuring the decompression amplification that drives DOM heap exhaustion
locations: org.keycloak.saml.processing.api.util.DeflateUtil#decode where the InflaterInputStream is created with no output size limit and wrapped in V1CountingStream by the agent
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in V1Counters, index 0 = cumulative decompressedBytes for current execution
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() calls V1Counters.reset() before each execution
signals.read: V1Guidance.handleResult() calls V1Counters.getDecompressedBytes() after each execution

plans.retention: Primary: keep input and update bestInner if decompressedBytes exceeds best-so-far (maximize amplification). Only primary retention updates bestInner — this guarantees bestInner always contains repetitive self-closing XML elements with ~1000:1 DEFLATE compression ratio matching the scale series. Secondary: add to corpus (but NOT bestInner) if compressed size exceeds previous best compressed size, for diversity only. Tertiary: random keep with 1% probability for diversity. bestInner tracked outside the corpus as a dedicated field, never subject to eviction or pollution by diversity mutations, ensuring exponential doubling chains maintain the high compression ratio structure.
mutation: repetition [R45a]: double the bestInner content via concatenation, chaining exponentially from 4-byte seed to ~32 MB plaintext = ~30 KB compressed in 23 doublings (70% probability)
dictionary [R45b]: insert XML tokens (<a/>, <b/>, <r>, </r>, whitespace) at random position in a corpus entry for structural diversity (15% probability)
byte-level: flip 1-4 random bytes in a corpus entry for diversity (10% probability)
cross-splice: take chunk from one corpus entry and splice into another at random position (5% probability)

encoder [R45c]: post-step applied to ALL outputs — compress mutated plaintext with java.util.zip.Deflater(Deflater.DEFLATED, true) matching target's Inflater(true) in DeflateUtil.decode(); shrink plaintext if compressed exceeds MAX_INPUT_SIZE; ensures 100% valid DEFLATE output (100% post-step)
